summary.text: Eric Maguire is a Republican state representative from Vermont's Rutland-5 District who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He lives in Rutland and previously directed a transitional housing and re-entry program.

paragraphs.text: Eric Maguire was born in Hyannis, Massachusetts, and lives in Rutland, Vermont.
He earned a B.S. in psychology and counseling from Liberty University.
His career included helping develop and later directing the Transitional Housing and Re-entry Program of the Vermont Achievement Center.
Maguire became board president of Rutland Turning Point and vice president of the board of Recovery Partners of Vermont, and he served on the board of the Rutland Restorative Justice Center.
Maguire assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and won re-election in 2024 with 96.6 percent of the vote in an uncontested general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
